subject: slender elf archer in a green hooded cloak with a tall recurve longbow in the left hand and a quiver on the back
motion: leaping upward and firing three glowing arrows downward
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: three glowing green arrows fanning downward

plan.source: Elf archer faces right; left hand holds tall bow upright ahead, right hand raised by back quiver; cloak draped; weight mostly on left foot, right slightly back; head turned right.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso dips, hips back; left hand lowers bow diagonally near thigh; right hand grabs three from quiver; head tilts down-right; left foot planted, right heel lifted, knees loaded.
frames.effect: Small green sparkles gather at right hand by quiver.

frames.pose: Takeoff: spring up; both feet leave ground, knees tuck; left arm lifts bow overhead; right hand sweeps forward, three nocked to string; head angles up; cloak lags.
frames.effect: Sparkles at nock; faint trail from right hand sweep to string.

frames.pose: Apex fire: torso arches; left arm fully extends aiming bow down-right; right hand at cheek releasing; legs tucked, toes back; head sights along bow.
frames.effect: Three glowing green arrows burst and fan downward with short trails; bowstring snap arc by grip.

frames.pose: Follow-through: descending; left arm recoils past near-vertical; right hand past chin to rib; legs extend slightly, toes down; head still tracking.
frames.effect: Fading green trails along the three downward paths; a few sparkles at bow tip.

frames.pose: Landing/settle: left foot plants forward, right toe then heel sets behind; knees bend; torso rises toward neutral; left hand lowers bow to upright; right hand drops toward quiver; head faces right.
